_comment_about_this_file: Paste-ready metadata for the Zenodo deposit form at https://zenodo.org/uploads/new. Each top-level field below maps to a Zenodo form field of the same name (Zenodo's form structure mirrors its REST API schema). Field-by-field copy is the recommended flow; if you prefer the REST API, this file's body can be POSTed to https://zenodo.org/api/deposit/depositions with an OAuth token. Brunson Hard-Rule: every value below is verifiable on https://unlocksaas.com/dataset – do not edit without updating the canonical source in app/src/lib/seo/dataset.ts first.

metadata.title: Indie SaaS Teardowns Dataset
metadata.description: Open, attribution-licensed dataset of indie SaaS landing-page, pricing, and head-to-head analyses, structured for researchers, indie founders, newsletter writers, and academics studying the post-launch pre-revenue SaaS market. The dataset bundles five tables – funnel teardowns, pricing teardowns, head-to-head comparisons, named-competitor alternatives, and category roundups – each derived from public landing pages of real indie SaaS products and analysed through Russell Brunson's Hook / Story / Offer framework. Every row carries a dated lastVerified timestamp; no fabricated metrics, no quoted copy, no slag. Distributed as a single JSON bundle, a flat denormalised CSV, and five per-table CSVs with richer table-specific columns. Canonical landing, full schema descriptions, citation metadata, and conversion recipes for Parquet/Arrow/Excel live at https://unlocksaas.com/dataset.
metadata.notes: Companion catalog listing on Hugging Face Datasets is published at the URL declared in the canonical Dataset.includedInDataCatalog graph on https://unlocksaas.com/dataset. The two distributions ship byte-identical artifacts; checksums match across catalogs by construction.
metadata.method: Each row is hand-curated from the live public landing page of a real indie SaaS product. The analytical lens is Russell Brunson's Hook / Story / Offer framework. Editorial standards documented at https://unlocksaas.com/editorial-policy. Verification rail at packages/seo/src/cli/validate-claims runs on every commit to ensure no schema-to-rendered drift between the dataset and the canonical /dataset landing page.

_field_notes.creators.orcid: Add an ORCID iD here if you have one (recommended for academic citation lineage). Format: '0000-0000-0000-0000'. Omit the field if you do not have one – Zenodo accepts creators without ORCID.
_field_notes.license: Zenodo's license dropdown accepts the literal value 'cc-by-4.0'. The form will render the human-readable license name. Do NOT change this without changing the canonical license on app/src/lib/seo/dataset.ts in the same commit – the two MUST match.
_field_notes.version: Bump in lockstep with DATASET_VERSION in app/src/lib/seo/dataset.ts. Zenodo records are immutable; a version bump creates a new DOI plus updates the concept DOI to point at the new version.
_field_notes.related_identifiers.relation: Zenodo's 'isDerivedFrom' is the canonical relation for a dataset deposit that derives from a public web resource. 'isAlternateIdentifier' names the parallel distribution. 'isPartOf' anchors the deposit to the broader UnlockSaaS work.
_field_notes.communities.identifier: Zenodo communities are optional curated buckets. 'open-data' is a broad community that increases discoverability. Add additional communities only if you have a real affiliation with them; do not paste community slugs you do not belong to.
